turn_processing_order: 1. Unit actions (farmer first, then hands in order) — interpreter L882-908

market.price_function: price = base + sign * amp * f(|inv - I0|); sign=+1 below I0 (scarcity up), -1 above I0 (glut down); amp = target * base / f(T); floored at 1
market.note_on_sell_supply: Sales at price==1 do NOT increase market inventory (L634). Sales at price>1 increase inventory by 1 per unit committed.
market.lockstep: Both players' order[i] quoted against same pre-commit inventory, then both commit one unit, then re-quote. _refresh_prices called once after all orders (L603).
market.order_truncation: Each player's market queue truncated to max_orders at L535; extras silently dropped.

movement.locked_traversal_note: Movement onto/through LOCKED tiles allowed (L313-316). Tile ops (PLANT/WATER/etc.) no-op on LOCKED (L323-324). Out-of-bounds rejected (L311-312).
movement.obstacles: No plant/building/animal/unit blocking. Manhattan routing sufficient.
movement.co_occupancy: Farmer and hands may share a tile.

plant_lifecycle.water_bonus_one_time: +1 per watered day in window; +2 if fertilized (L385)
plant_lifecycle.decay: After max_lifespan_step, yield_units -=1 every 2 steps until 0 -> WEED (L729-736)
plant_lifecycle.ongoing_production: At end-of-day, if days_since_first % interval == 0 and production_count <= max_yield: +2 if (watered AND fertilized) else +1 (L770)

plant_atomicity.rule: If total PLANT requests for a crop this turn exceed available seeds, ALL PLANT requests for that crop are converted to PASS (L889-902). First-come-first-served does NOT apply within a single turn.
plant_atomicity.implementation: interpreter pre-scans unit_actions, builds blocked set, rewrites blocked PLANTs to PASS before _apply_unit_action.

seed_and_shed.seeds_note: Seeds live in private['seeds'], never in shed, never PICKUP. PLANT consumes directly (L368-370). No cap on seeds.

hire.cost_sequence: fib(n) * farmHandCostMult where n = hires_today; fib: 1,1,2,3,5,8,13,21,... (L659-668)
hire.timing: HIRE processed in market phase (after unit actions). New hand appended to farm['hands'] (L677) but unit actions already done, so hand acts next turn at earliest.
hire.last_hour_rule: No explicit last-hour block in source; spec recommends not hiring on last hour (no future value). This is a policy constraint, not engine-enforced.

end_of_day_refresh: 1. _daily_refresh_plants: watered->consecutive_unwatered=0 else +1; >=2 -> WEED; ongoing production ticks (L739-772)
2. _daily_refresh_animals: fed->consecutive_unfed=0 else +1; >=2 -> escape (structure remains); production + care bonus (L775-803)
3. _spawn_weeds: empty tiles get weed with weedSpawnChance (L806-810)
4. _drop_inventories_to_shed: all unit inventories -> shed, overflow lost (L813-827, called L848)

animal_lifecycle.fertilizer_regeneration: Every surviving animal: fertilizer_available=True at end-of-day (L801)
animal_lifecycle.care_bonus_note: L800: pending_care_bonus += 1 if cared_today AND fed_today. Bonus consumed on next fed production day (L796). NOT +2 as some docs claim.
animal_lifecycle.feed_source: FEED consumes WHEAT from unit inventory only (L486). No auto-feed from shed.
animal_lifecycle.production: At end-of-day, if days_since_first % interval == 0: yield_units += 1 + bonus (capped at max_held) (L792-797)

sell_fertilizer.source_truth: L571: op=='SELL' and item in PRODUCTS; PRODUCTS includes FERTILIZER (L25). _commit_unit SELL branch (L628-636) has no FERTILIZER special-case.
sell_fertilizer.agents_md_claim: AGENTS.md says 'Fertilizer can only be bought, not sold.' — this is FALSE per source.

random_agent_reproducibility.reason: random_agent creates rng = random.Random() with no seed each call (L997). end-of-day weed/shop use seeded rng (L841), but the 'random' BUILTIN AGENT is not reproducible.
random_agent_reproducibility.implication: Do not use built-in 'random' as a primary regression opponent.

file_loader.rule: kaggle_environments.agent.get_last_callable selects the LAST callable defined in the file, not by name 'agent'.
file_loader.requirement: In submission main.py, `agent` must be the last callable defined; no functions/classes/lambdas/callable aliases after it.

spec_premise_verification.locked_tile_movement_fixed: Confirmed in 1.32.3 source (L313-316). Cannot verify this was a 'fix' vs older version without history, but current behavior matches spec claim.
